name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that produces polished decks without generic, cookie-cutter output.
problem: Creating professional presentations is time-consuming, and most AI tools generate bland, templated slides that require heavy manual cleanup. Chronicle 2.0 aims to automate deck creation while preserving visual quality and originality. This saves teams hours of design and formatting work without sacrificing brand or storytelling integrity.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with structured, on-brand visuals
Creating internal business updates or strategy presentations quickly
Generating client-facing proposals or project summaries
Producing polished conference or keynote slides from raw notes
